The sky is a deep blue, transitioning into lighter hues near the horizon, suggesting the sun has recently set. The Petronas Twin Towers: These iconic twin skyscrapers dominate the scene with their illuminated facades. The lights on the towers create a warm glow against the cool blue sky, making them stand out prominently.
